text.hero_title: Listening to what the soil has been trying to say
text.hero_body: Soil Genesis reads how living soil is functioning and helps restore it - not only what the soil contains, but how it lives, responds, and recovers.
text.hero_note: A living-soil intelligence and restoration platform
text.vision_title: Nearly everything we eat begins in the soil
text.vision_body_1: Soil health shapes most life on land, which makes soil the highest-leverage place to strengthen everything downstream - the plants that feed us and the communities they sustain.
text.vision_body_2: Most soil tools read what soil contains. Almost none read how it lives, responds, and recovers. That living layer is exactly where Soil Genesis begins.
text.vision_quote: Heal the soil, and you strengthen the whole system growing above it.
text.insight_body: Living soil responds when it is probed. It reacts, settles, and recovers, and that response can carry information about the state of the whole system, much as a living body's rhythms reveal condition over time.
text.insight_quote: Soil has a signal, and the signal carries its state.
text.platform_title: One connected loop, not a single device
text.platform_body: Read the soil. Interpret its state. Restore structure and biology. Verify the change. Then read again, so every action teaches the next one.
text.platform_step_1_body: Observe how living soil responds and changes over time.
text.platform_step_2_body: Turn response patterns into a bounded picture of system state.
text.platform_step_3_body: Support the structure and biology that allow soil to function.
text.platform_step_4_body: Measure whether the system changed, recovered, or held its new state.
text.platform_step_5_body: Use what the soil reveals to guide the next decision.
text.practice_body: A microbial-coated cover-crop seed blend designed to rebuild compacted subsoil into persistent vertical channels that future crop roots can follow, without mechanical disturbance.
text.practice_boundary: Development boundary: SoilBridge Deep is presented as a structural soil-restoration tool. We do not make pesticidal, disease-control, or guaranteed-yield claims.
text.practice_metric_body: Target reduction in penetrometer resistance at 12-18 inch depth, treatment compared with compacted control, subject to field validation.
text.practice_user_body: Long-term no-till operators who already measure compaction, especially in heavy clay and silt loam soils.
text.portfolio_body: The portfolio is organized by role, not as eight disconnected products. Each invention adds a different layer to the same soil-restoration loop.
text.portfolio_card_1_body: Sensing how living soil responds and how its state changes over time.
text.portfolio_card_2_body: Turning measured response into practical readiness, comparison, and verification.
text.portfolio_card_3_body: Placing structure, living biology, and measured conditioning where roots and fungi work.
text.portfolio_card_4_body: Extending the same sensing and restoration logic across land, contamination, and scale.
text.architecture_caption: distinct inventive concepts identified across eight inventions
text.architecture_title: A platform with depth, structure, and a serious protection path
text.architecture_body_1: A former U.S. patent examiner reviewed the portfolio and identified 49 distinct inventive concepts across the eight inventions. Within each invention, an architecture-level concept sits above component concepts that carry their own inventive substance.
text.architecture_body_2: What stood out was the integrated architecture: the concepts reinforce one another, while the written record stays clear about what has been built, what is being tested, and what still requires validation.
text.lab_title: A business that pays for its own science
text.lab_body: The lab is envisioned as the engine that turns the platform into a durable operation: services generate revenue, research validates the technology, and each project adds to a soil-intelligence dataset.
text.lab_pillar_1_body: Season-long soil work to develop fungal and microbial inoculants matched to a grower's fields, beginning with specialty crops.
text.lab_pillar_2_body: Where Soil Genesis technologies are tested, refined, and validated under real conditions.
text.lab_pillar_3_body: Signals paired with real outcomes, creating a proprietary dataset that sharpens the tools over time.
text.lab_flywheel: Services fund the research. The research validates the platform. The data makes all of it smarter.
text.progress_title: The interest is arriving, and the foundation is set
text.progress_body: Soil Genesis is early and building. The work is moving through outside review, funding pathways, hardware development, and structured validation, with the unfinished parts named rather than hidden.
text.progress_item_1_body: A National Science Foundation program director invited Soil Genesis to submit a full federal funding proposal.
text.progress_item_2_body: Experienced patent counsel completed a strategic review of the full eight-invention portfolio.
text.progress_item_3_body: The next precision sensing core is being built and tested against the validated field-response platform.
text.progress_item_4_body: Testing is moving from bench behavior and field response toward controlled comparative validation.
text.partner_title: Help build the next layer of living-soil intelligence
text.partner_body: We are seeking research, commercial, and capital partners who understand that durable restoration begins by reading the system, supporting what allows it to function, and verifying what changes.
text.partner_status_3_body: Aligned research, commercial, and capital partners
